title: National watershed polygons (UTM)
description: Belize national watershed polygons in UTM projection. Single attribute column `WATERSHED` carrying the watershed name (e.g. Big Creek, Baracouta, Potts Creek). Used as the geometry target for `watersheds-all-ebin-clade-detail` and `watersheds-all-nbs-scores`, which both key on watershed name across multiple project sites (Placencia + Caye Caulker).
